name: Brother Iscarius

bonuses.name: Architect of Ruin
bonuses.text: At the start of each of Brother Iscarius turns, the GM gains a point 1 Ruin

bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: Brother Iscarius may use Ruin actions and has 4 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: Chosen of the Writ
bonuses.text: Brother Iscarius gains +2 bonus dice to all Interaction Attacks.

bonuses.name: Mark of Chaos
bonuses.text: Brother Iscarius has a Mark of Chaos (Undivided)

bonuses.name: Space Marine Implants
bonuses.text: Brother Iscarius gains bonus dice and options for actions from Space Marine Implants (W&G Core Rulebook p.75)

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. Add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks Brother Iscarius makes this Round.

abilities.name: Death to the False Emperor!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to charge, gaining +2 bonus dice to the attack Test.

abilities.name: Veteran of the Long War
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin to add the game's Tier as ED to all attacks Brother Iscarius makes this round.

note: Veteran of the Long War prints twice (once as RUIN, once untyped); both kept.
